core_struggle: A mother of two who is back at work and feels she is half a mother and half a PM, shattered by her daughter's question.
mirror: You give the day everything, then lie awake replaying every conversation.

queries.hook: The feeling of being split between the mother you are and the PM you are, and the ache of a child's question that lands like a verdict.
queries.diagnose: When duties pull in different directions and fear clouds which one is truly yours, the mind cannot settle; it runs the same loop until one is chosen.
queries.steady: Stay the same in praise and blame; what is yours to do is yours to do, and the result is not in your hands.
queries.act: Do your own duty without shrinking to fit either picture; give each role its full attention in its own time, and let the rest go.
queries.story: A mother and queen torn between two kingdoms, who learned that duty is not split but chosen, and that the heart follows the hand that acts.

bridge: The split between the mother you are and the PM you are is what the Gita calls duty pulled in two directions, and it asks which one is truly yours.
week_thesis: From feeling split between two roles to finding one duty at a time, and giving each its full presence.

week_beats.hook: You recognise the split and the child's question, named without blame.
week_beats.diagnose: You see that the real tension is between two duties both claiming you, and that the loop will not stop until one is chosen.
week_beats.steady: You hold that what is yours to do is yours to do, and the result is not in your hands.
week_beats.act: You try giving each role its full attention in its own time, and letting the rest go.
week_beats.story: A mother torn between two kingdoms shows you that duty is not split but chosen, and that the heart follows the hand that acts.

insight: Your daughter asked a question you already carry the answer to. Underneath is the conflict between the mother you want to be and the work you have built.
seat: a mother of two who is back at work and feels she is failing at both
life_context: A mother in her mid-thirties, back at work after her second baby; every day she feels split between the pull of her children and the demands of her job, and her daughter's question in the car broke her.
details: back at work after second baby
feels half a mother and half a PM
daughter asked why she misses school things
cried in the car after the question
